    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.head: _Node[K, V] = _Node(cast_key=None, value=cast_value=None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        self.tail: _Node[K, V] = _Node(cast_key=None, value=cast_value=None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head
        self._size: int = 0

    @property
    def size(self) -> int:
        return self._size

    def append_left(self, node: _Node[K, V]) -> None:
        """Insert node right after head (most-recently-used position)."""
        node.prev = self.head
        node.next = self.head
